component.name: SegmentedControl
component.description: Single-selection action control for choosing between mutually exclusive options such as Perro/Gato.

antiPatterns.reason: Use Button or IconButton when the choices are not mutually exclusive.

accessibility.keyboardSupport: Options use radio semantics. Arrow-key roving focus can be added when the group becomes more complex.
accessibility.screenReader: The radiogroup exposes its label first, then each option is read in DOM/visual order with aria-checked, aria-posinset, and aria-setsize.
accessibility.focusManagement: Each option has visible focus. Active state is not conveyed by color alone. For Perro/Gato the order is Perro first, then Gato.
